akis.alinti: Postees has racked up over 37k stars on GitHub, and it's built with TypeScript, Next.js, and Nest.js.
What sets it apart is the built-in AI agent layer.
It also ships a public API, N8N node, and make .com integration for full automation.
If you want full control of your data and unlimited posts, self-host Postees and run the AI Copilot on your own keys.
